title: Red Hat Libuser: attackers can gain admin rights
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. Ready-made attack tools are public.

category.label: Computers, phones and browsers
category.why: It runs on staff computers, phones or browsers.
category.doThis: Install the latest updates on every device, and turn on automatic updates.

summary: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 9, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
